title: Navigation hover and selection
guidance: Use a rounded rectangle for desktop hover, matching the selected tile family. Keep mobile selection icon-based. Keep the bottom bar at the viewport bottom on sparse pages.

Latest human direction: top navigation remains sticky while scrolling across pages. Retain short/enlarged reading-space fallback where persistent chrome would consume content. Layout-origin hamburger/menu does not get content-modal blur.
Back to workspace has the same shared back-link appearance even when shown inside a card; the lab must not teach a different button version.

decisions.title: Rounded desktop hover and selection
decisions.reason: Desktop hover uses the same rounded geometry as selection; the mobile selected state remains icon based.

decisions.title: Chrome follows available height
decisions.reason: Persistent navigation stays at the viewport edge. Short/enlarged layouts use ordinary document flow when chrome would consume the content area.

parameters.name: Navigation geometry
parameters.description: No extra header top reflection; selected Round10 lower/bottom rim is retained.

parameters.name: State layout
parameters.description: observeCompactNavigation measures actual content; header menus and keyboard focus use native anchors/buttons.
